name: Hotel Haflingerhof
beschreibung: Hotel Haflingerhof is situated in the high valley of Wildschönau in the village of Auffach. Framed by majestic alpine peaks, it provides a quiet and authentic rural setting. In winter, guests enjoy close proximity to the premier Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau ski domain, while summer reveals numerous scenic hiking paths. Accommodations feature traditional wood finishes, an indoor swimming pool, saunas, a steam bath, and a restaurant serving regional culinary classics.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Haflingerhof in Auffach in the Wildschönau valley features an indoor pool, a sauna wellness complex, Tyrolean dining, and direct access to Ski Juwel.
